Ya'ni hum ne tere seene ko munawwar kardiya, choda, kushada aur rahmat-o-karam wala kardiya aur jagah hai Faman yuridillahu an yahdiyahu yashrah sadrahu lil-Islam (6:125), ya'ni jise Allah hidayat dena chahta hai us ke seene ko Islam ke liye khol deta hai. Jis tarah aap ka seena kushada kardiya gaya tha, isi tarah aap ki shariat bhi kushadagi wali, narmi aur aasani wali banadi, jis mein na to koi haraj hai na tangi, na turshi, na takleef aur sakhti. Aur yeh bhi kaha gaya hai ke murad Me'raj wali raat seene ka shaq kiya jana hai, jaise ke Malik bin Sa'sa'ah ki riwayat se pehle guzar chuka, Imam Tirmidhi ne is hadith ko yahin warid kiya hai. Lekin yeh yaad rahe ke yeh dono waqiyat murad ho sakte hain, ya'ni Me'raj ki raat seene ka shaq kiya jana aur seene ko Raz-e-Ilahi ka ganjina banadena. Wallahu A'lam.

Hazrat Ubayy bin Ka'b R.A farmate hain ke Hazrat Abu Hurairah R.A badi daleri se Rasool Allah ﷺ se woh baatein pooch liya karte the jise dusre na pooch sakte the. Ek martaba sawal kiya ke Ya Rasool Allah ﷺ! Amr-e-Nabuwwat mein sab se pehle aap ne kya dekha? Aap sambhal baithe aur farmane lage: Abu Hurairah! Main das saal kuch mah ka tha, jangal mein khada tha ke main ne upar aasman ki taraf se kuch aawaz suni ke ek shakhs dusre se keh raha hai kya yeh wohi hain? Ab do shakhs mere samne aaye jin ke munh aise munawwar the ke main ne aise kabhi nahin dekhe aur aisi khushbu aa rahi thi ke mere dimagh ne aisi khushbu kabhi nahin soonghi aur aise kapde pehne hue the ke main ne kabhi kisi par aise kapde nahin dekhe aur aakar unhon ne mere dono bazu thaam liye lekin mujhe yeh bhi nahin maloom hota tha ke koi mere bazu thaame hue hai. Phir ek ne dusre se kaha ke inhe lita do, chunancha us ne lita diya lekin is mein bhi na mujhe takleef hui na bura mehsoos hua. Phir ek ne dusre se kaha in ka seena shaq karo, chunancha mera seena cheer diya lekin na to mujhe is mein kuch dukh hua aur na main ne khud dekha. Phir kaha is mein se ghull-o-ghish, hasad-o-bughz sab nikal do, chunancha us ne ek khoon basta jaisi koi cheez nikali aur use phenk diya. Phir us ne kaha is mein ra'fat-o-rahmat, raham-o-karam bhar do, phir ek chandi jaisi cheez jitni nikali thi utni daal di. Phir mere daayein paanv ka angootha hila kar kaha jaiye aur salamti se zindagi guzariye. Ab main chala to main ne dekha ke har chhote par mere dil mein shafqat hai aur har bade par rahmat hai (Musnad Ahmad).

Phir farman hai ke hum ne tera bojh utaar diya. Yeh isi ma'ni mein hai ke Allah ne aap ke agle pichle gunah maaf farmadiye. Jis bojh ne teri kamar se aawaz nikalwa di thi, ya'ni jis ne teri kamar ko bojhal kardiya tha. Hum ne tera zikr buland kiya. Hazrat Mujahid R.A farmate hain ya'ni jahan mera zikr kiya jayega wahan tera zikr kiya jayega, jaise Ashhadu an la ilaha illallah wa ashhadu anna Muhammadan Rasulullah.

Qatadah (R.H) farmate hain ke duniya aur aakhirat mein Allah Ta'ala ne aap ka zikr buland kardiya, koi khatib, koi wa'iz, koi kalma-go, koi namazi aisa nahin jo Allah ki wahdaniyat ka aur aap ki risalat ka kalma na padhta ho. Ibn-e-Jarir mein hai ke Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ke paas Hazrat Jibra'il (A.S) aaye aur farmaya ke mera aur aap ka Rab farmata hai ke main aap ka zikr kis tarah buland karoon? Aap ne farmaya Allah hi ko poora ilm hai. Farmaya jab main zikr kiya jaaun to aap ka bhi zikr kiya jayega. Ibn-e-Abi Hatim mein hai Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) farmate hain main ne apne Rab se ek sawal kiya lekin na karta to achha hota, main ne kaha Allah mujh se pehle nabiyon mein se kisi ke liye tu ne hawa ko tabe-dar kardiya tha, kisi ke hathon murdon ko zinda kardiya tha, to Allah Ta'ala ne mujh se farmaya kya tujhe main ne yateem pa kar jagah nahin di? Main ne kaha beshak. Farmaya rah-e-gum-karda pa kar main ne tujhe hidayat nahin ki? Main ne kaha beshak. Farmaya kya faqeer pa kar ghani nahin banadiya? Main ne kaha beshak. Farmaya kya main ne tera seena khol nahin diya? Kya main ne tera zikr buland nahin kiya? Main ne kaha beshak kiya hai. Abu Nu'aim Dala'il-un-Nubuwwah mein laye hain ke Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya jab main farigh hua us cheez se jis ka hukm mujhe mere Rab Azza-wa-Jal ne kiya tha, aasman aur zameen ke kaam se, to main ne kaha Allah mujh se pehle jitne ambiya hue un sab ki tu ne takreem ki, Ibrahim (A.S) ko Khalil banaya, Musa (A.S) ko Kaleem banaya, Dawood (A.S) ke liye pahadon ko musakhkhar kiya, Sulaiman (A.S) ke liye hawaon aur shayateen ko bhi tabe-dar banaya aur Isa (A.S) ke hath par murde zinda karaye, pas mere liye kya kiya hai? Allah Ta'ala ne farmaya ke kya main ne tujhe in sab se afzal cheez nahin di ke mere zikr ke sath hi tera zikr bhi kiya jata hai aur main ne teri ummat ke seenon ko aisa kardiya ke woh Quran ko qira'at se padhte hain. Yeh main ne kisi agli ummat ko nahin diya aur main ne tujhe apne Arsh ke khazanon mein se khazana diya jo La-haula-wala-quwwata-illa-billahil-Aliyyil-Azeem hai. Ibn-e-Abbas (R.A) aur Mujahid (R.H) farmate hain ke is se murad azan hai, yani azan mein aap ka zikr hai jis tarah Hazrat Hassan (R.A) ke sheron mein hai.

Aghar-un alaihi lin-nubuwwati khatamun minallahi min noorin yaloohu wa yash-hadu, wa damma-l-ilahu isman-nabi ismihi idza qala fil-khamsi-l-mu-azzinu ash-hadu, wa shaqqa lahu min ismihi liyujillahu, fadzu-l-arshi mahmoodun wa hadza Muhammadun (ﷺ). Ya'ni Allah Ta'ala ne mohr-e-nubuwwat ko apne paas ka ek noor bana kar aap par sabt farmaya jo aap ki risalat ki gawah hai. Apne naam ke saath apne Nabi ka naam mila liya jabke paanchwein waqt ash-hadu kehta hai. Aap ki izzat-o-jalal ke izhar ke liye apne naam mein se aap ka naam nikala, dekho woh Arsh wala Mahmood hai aur aap Muhammad hain (ﷺ). Aur log kehte hain ke aglon pichlon mein Allah Ta'ala ne aap ka zikr buland kiya aur tamam Anbiya (Alaihimas Salam) se roz-e-meesaq mein ahd liya gaya ke woh aap par iman layein aur apni apni ummaton ko bhi aap par iman lane ka hukm karein. Phir aap ki ummat mein aap ke zikr ko mashhoor kiya ke Allah ke zikr ke saath aap ka zikr kiya jaye. Sarsari ne kitni achi baat bayan farmayi hai, farmate hain ke farzon ki azan sahih nahin hoti magar aap ke pyare aur meethe naam se jo pasandida aur ache munh se ada ho. Aur farmate hain ke tum nahin dekhte ke hamari azan aur hamara farz sahih nahin hota jab tak ke aap ka zikr baar-baar is mein na aaye. Phir Allah Tabarak-o-Ta'ala takrar aur takeed ke saath do do dafa farmata hai ke sakhti ke saath aasani, dushwari ke saath saholat hai. Ibn-e-Abi Hatim mein hai ke Rasoolullah (ﷺ) baithe hue thay aur aap ke samne ek patthar tha, pas logon ne kaha aur sakhti aaye aur is patthar par ghus jaye to aasani hi aayegi aur isi mein jayegi aur ise nikal layegi, is par yeh aayat utri. Musnad-e-Bazzar mein hai Huzoor (ﷺ) farmate hain ke agar dushwari is patthar mein dakhil ho jaye to aasani aa kar ise nikale gi, phir aap ne is aayat ki tilawat ki. Yeh hadith Aiz bin Shuraih Hazrat Anas (R.A) se riwayat karte hain aur un ke bare mein Abu Hatim Razi ka faisla hai ke un ki hadith mein za'f hai aur Ibn-e-Masood (R.A) se yeh mauqoof marwi hai. Hazrat Hasan (R.H) farmate hain log kehte thay ke ek sakhti do aasaniyon par ghalib nahin aa sakti. Hazrat Hasan Ibn-e-Jareer mein marwi hai ke An-Hazrat (ﷺ) ek din shadan-o-farhan aaye aur hanste hue farmane lage har-giz ek dushwari do narmiyon par ghalib nahin aa sakti. Phir is aayat ki aap ne tilawat ki, yeh hadith mursal hai. Hazrat Qatada (R.H) farmate hain ke hum se zikr kiya gaya hai ke Rasoolullah (ﷺ) ne apne as-hab ko khush-khabri sunayi ke do aasaniyon par ek sakhti ghalib nahin aa sakti. Matlab yeh hai ke 'usra' ke lafz ko to dono jagah ma'rifa laye hain to woh mufrad hua aur 'yusr' ke lafz ko nakira laye hain to woh muta'addid ho gaya.

Ek hadith mein hai ke ma'oonat ya'ni imdad-e-Ilahi ba-qadr-e-ma'oonat ya'ni takleef ke aasman se nazil hoti hai, ya'ni sabr musibat ki miqdar par nazil hota hai. Hazrat Imam Shafi'i (R.H) farmate hain: Sabrun jameelan ma aqrabal faraja, man raqaballaha fil amri naja, man sadaqallaha lam yanlahu aza, wa man rajahu yakoon haithu raja. Ya'ni achha sabr aasaniyon se kya hi qareeb hai? Apne kamon mein Allah Ta'ala ka lihaz rakhne wala, nijat yafta hai, Allah Ta'ala ki baton ki tasdeeq karne wale ko koi eza nahin pahunchti, us se bhalai ki umeed rakhne wala use apni umeed ke sath hi pata hai. Hazrat Abu Hatim Sajistani (R.H) ke ashaar hain ke jab mayusi dil par qabza kar leti hai aur seena bawajood kushadgi ke tang ho jata hai, takleefein gher leti hain aur musibatein dera jama leti hain, koi chara sujhayi nahin deta aur koi tadbeer-e-nijat kargar nahin hoti, us waqt achanak Allah ki madad aa pahunchti hai. Aur woh duaon ka sunne wala bareek been Allah us sakhti ko aasani se aur us takleef ko rahat mein badal deta hai. Tangiyan jab ke bharpoor aa padi hain, Parwardigar wahan wus'atein nazil farma kar nuqsan ko faide se badal deta hai. Kisi aur shayar ne kaha hai: Wa rubba nazilin yadeequ bihil fata zar'an, wa indallahi minha al-makhraju. Kamalat falamma istahlat halaqatuha, farijat wa kana yazunnuha la tufraju. Ya'ni bahut si aisi musibatein insan par nazil hoti hain jin se woh tang-dil ho jata hai halanke Allah ke paas un se chhutkara bhi hai. Jab yeh musibatein kamil ho jati hain aur is zanjeer ke halqe mazboot ho jate hain aur insan guman karne lagta hai ke bhala yeh kya hatengi, ke achanak us Raheem-o-Kareem Allah ki shafqat bhari nazrein padti hain aur us musibat ko is tarah door karta hai ke goya aayi hi na thi. Is ke baad irshad-e-Bari hota hai ke jab tu dunyawi kamon se aur yahan ke ashghal se fursat paye to hamari ibadaton mein lag ja aur farigh-ul-bal ho kar dili tawajjuh ke sath hamare samne aajizi mein lag ja, apni niyat khalis kar le, apni poori raghbat ke sath hamari janab ki taraf mutawajjah ho ja. Isi ma'ni ki woh hadith hai jis ki sehat par ittefaq hai jis mein hai ke khana samne majood hone ke waqt namaz nahin aur is halat mein bhi ke insan ko pakhana peshab ki hajat ho. Aur hadith mein hai ke jab namaz khadi ki jaye aur sham ka khana samne majood ho to pehle khane se faraghat hasil kar lo. Hazrat Mujahid (R.H) is ayat ki tafsir mein farmate hain ke jab amr-e-dunya se farigh ho kar namaz ke liye khade ho to mehnat ke sath ibadat karo aur mashghuliyat ke sath Rabb ki taraf tawajjuh kar. Hazrat Ibn-e-Mas'ood (R.A) farmate hain ke jab farz namaz se farigh ho to tahajjud ki namaz mein khada ho. Hazrat Abdullah bin Mas'ood (R.A) farmate hain ke namaz se farigh ho kar baithe hue apne Rabb ki taraf tawajjuh kar. Hazrat Abdullah bin Abbas (R.A) farmate hain ya'ni dua kar. Zaid bin Aslam aur Zahhak farmate hain jihad se farigh ho kar Allah ki ibadat mein lag ja. Thauri (R.H) farmate hain apni niyat aur apni raghbat Allah hi ki taraf rakh.

Surah Al-Nashrah ki tafsir Allah ke fazl-o-karam se khatam hui. Falhamdulillah.

Abu Nu'aim Dala'il-un-Nubuwwah mein laye hain ke Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya jab main farigh hua us cheez se jis ka hukm mujhe mere Rab Azza-wa-Jal ne kiya tha, aasman aur zameen ke kaam se, to main ne kaha Allah mujh se pehle jitne ambiya hue un sab ki tu ne takreem ki, Ibrahim (A.S) ko Khalil banaya, Musa (A.S) ko Kaleem banaya, Dawood (A.S) ke liye pahadon ko musakhkhar kiya, Sulaiman (A.S) ke liye hawaon aur shayateen ko bhi tabe-dar banaya aur Isa (A.S) ke hath par murde zinda karaye, pas mere liye kya kiya hai? Yeh main ne kisi agli ummat ko nahin diya aur main ne tujhe apne Arsh ke khazanon mein se khazana diya jo La-haula-wala-quwwata-illa-billahil-Aliyyil-Azeem hai. Ibn-e-Abbas (R.A) aur Mujahid (R.H) farmate hain ke is se murad azan hai, yani azan mein aap ka zikr hai jis tarah Hazrat Hassan (R.A) ke sheron mein hai.

Aghar-un alaihi lin-nubuwwati khatamun minallahi min noorin yaloohu wa yash-hadu, wa damma-l-ilahu isman-nabi ismihi idza qala fil-khamsi-l-mu-azzinu ash-hadu, wa shaqqa lahu min ismihi liyujillahu, fadzu-l-arshi mahmoodun wa hadza Muhammadun (ﷺ). Ya'ni Allah Ta'ala ne mohr-e-nubuwwat ko apne paas ka ek noor bana kar aap par sabt farmaya jo aap ki risalat ki gawah hai. Apne naam ke saath apne Nabi ka naam mila liya jabke paanchwein waqt ash-hadu kehta hai. Aap ki izzat-o-jalal ke izhar ke liye apne naam mein se aap ka naam nikala, dekho woh Arsh wala Mahmood hai aur aap Muhammad hain (ﷺ). Aur log kehte hain ke aglon pichlon mein Allah Ta'ala ne aap ka zikr buland kiya aur tamam Anbiya (Alaihimas Salam) se roz-e-meesaq mein ahd liya gaya ke woh aap par iman layein aur apni apni ummaton ko bhi aap par iman lane ka hukm karein. Phir aap ki ummat mein aap ke zikr ko mashhoor kiya ke Allah ke zikr ke saath aap ka zikr kiya jaye. Sarsari ne kitni achi baat bayan farmayi hai, farmate hain ke farzon ki azan sahih nahin hoti magar aap ke pyare aur meethe naam se jo pasandida aur ache munh se ada ho. Aur farmate hain ke tum nahin dekhte ke hamari azan aur hamara farz sahih nahin hota jab tak ke aap ka zikr baar-baar is mein na aaye. Phir Allah Tabarak-o-Ta'ala takrar aur takeed ke saath do do dafa farmata hai ke sakhti ke saath aasani, dushwari ke saath saholat hai. Ibn-e-Abi Hatim mein hai ke Rasoolullah (ﷺ) baithe hue thay aur aap ke samne ek patthar tha, pas logon ne kaha aur sakhti aaye aur is patthar par ghus jaye to aasani hi aayegi aur isi mein jayegi aur ise nikal layegi, is par yeh aayat utri. Musnad-e-Bazzar mein hai Huzoor (ﷺ) farmate hain ke agar dushwari is patthar mein dakhil ho jaye to aasani aa kar ise nikale gi, phir aap ne is aayat ki tilawat ki. Yeh hadith Aiz bin Shuraih Hazrat Anas (R.A) se riwayat karte hain aur un ke bare mein Abu Hatim Razi ka faisla hai ke un ki hadith mein za'f hai aur Ibn-e-Masood (R.A) se yeh mauqoof marwi hai. Hazrat Hasan (R.H) farmate hain log kehte thay ke ek sakhti do aasaniyon par ghalib nahin aa sakti. Hazrat Hasan Ibn-e-Jareer mein marwi hai ke An-Hazrat (ﷺ) ek din shadan-o-farhan aaye aur hanste hue farmane lage har-giz ek dushwari do narmiyon par ghalib nahin aa sakti. Phir is aayat ki aap ne tilawat ki, yeh hadith mursal hai. Tangiyan jab ke bharpoor aa padi hain, Parwardigar wahan wus'atein nazil farma kar nuqsan ko faide se badal deta hai. Phir ek ne dusre se kaha ke inhe lita do, chunancha us ne lita diya lekin is mein bhi na mujhe takleef hui na bura mehsoos hua. Phir ek ne dusre se kaha in ka seena shaq karo, chunancha mera seena cheer diya lekin na to mujhe is mein kuch dukh hua aur na main ne khud dekha. Phir kaha is mein se ghull-o-ghish, hasad-o-bughz sab nikal do, chunancha us ne ek khoon basta jaisi koi cheez nikali aur use phenk diya. Phir us ne kaha is mein ra'fat-o-rahmat, raham-o-karam bhar do, phir ek chandi jaisi cheez jitni nikali thi utni daal di. Phir mere daayein paanv ka angootha hila kar kaha jaiye aur salamti se zindagi guzariye. Ab main chala to main ne dekha ke har chhote par mere dil mein shafqat hai aur har bade par rahmat hai (Musnad Ahmad).

Phir farman hai ke hum ne tera bojh utaar diya. Yeh isi ma'ni mein hai ke Allah ne aap ke agle pichle gunah maaf farmadiye. Jis bojh ne teri kamar se aawaz nikalwa di thi, ya'ni jis ne teri kamar ko bojhal kardiya tha. Hum ne tera zikr buland kiya. Hazrat Mujahid R.A farmate hain ya'ni jahan mera zikr kiya jayega wahan tera zikr kiya jayega, jaise Ashhadu an la ilaha illallah wa ashhadu anna Muhammadan Rasulullah.

Qatadah (R.H) farmate hain ke duniya aur aakhirat mein Allah Ta'ala ne aap ka zikr buland kardiya, koi khatib, koi wa'iz, koi kalma-go, koi namazi aisa nahin jo Allah ki wahdaniyat ka aur aap ki risalat ka kalma na padhta ho. Ibn-e-Jarir mein hai ke Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ke paas Hazrat Jibra'il (A.S) aaye aur farmaya ke mera aur aap ka Rab farmata hai ke main aap ka zikr kis tarah buland karoon? Aap ne farmaya Allah hi ko poora ilm hai. Farmaya jab main zikr kiya jaaun to aap ka bhi zikr kiya jayega. Ibn-e-Abi Hatim mein hai Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) farmate hain main ne apne Rab se ek sawal kiya lekin na karta to achha hota, main ne kaha Allah mujh se pehle nabiyon mein se kisi ke liye tu ne hawa ko tabe-dar kardiya tha, kisi ke hathon murdon ko zinda kardiya tha, to Allah Ta'ala ne mujh se farmaya kya tujhe main ne yateem pa kar jagah nahin di? Main ne kaha beshak. Farmaya rah-e-gum-karda pa kar main ne tujhe hidayat nahin ki? Main ne kaha beshak. Farmaya kya faqeer pa kar ghani nahin banadiya? Main ne kaha beshak. Farmaya kya main ne tera seena khol nahin diya? Kya main ne tera zikr buland nahin kiya? Main ne kaha beshak kiya hai. Abu Nu'aim Dala'il-un-Nubuwwah mein laye hain ke Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya jab main farigh hua us cheez se jis ka hukm mujhe mere Rab Azza-wa-Jal ne kiya tha, aasman aur zameen ke kaam se, to main ne kaha Allah mujh se pehle jitne ambiya hue un sab ki tu ne takreem ki, Ibrahim (A.S) ko Khalil banaya, Musa (A.S) ko Kaleem banaya, Dawood (A.S) ke liye pahadon ko musakhkhar kiya, Sulaiman (A.S) ke liye hawaon aur shayateen ko bhi tabe-dar banaya aur Isa (A.S) ke hath par murde zinda karaye, pas mere liye kya kiya hai? Allah Ta'ala ne farmaya ke kya main ne tujhe in sab se afzal cheez nahin di ke mere zikr ke sath hi tera zikr bhi kiya jata hai aur main ne teri ummat ke seenon ko aisa kardiya ke woh Quran ko qira'at se padhte hain. Yeh main ne kisi agli ummat ko nahin diya aur main ne tujhe apne Arsh ke khazanon mein se khazana diya jo La-haula-wala-quwwata-illa-billahil-Aliyyil-Azeem hai. Ibn-e-Abbas (R.A) aur Mujahid (R.H) farmate hain ke is se murad azan hai, yani azan mein aap ka zikr hai jis tarah Hazrat Hassan (R.A) ke sheron mein hai.

Aghar-un alaihi lin-nubuwwati khatamun minallahi min noorin yaloohu wa yash-hadu, wa damma-l-ilahu isman-nabi ismihi idza qala fil-khamsi-l-mu-azzinu ash-hadu, wa shaqqa lahu min ismihi liyujillahu, fadzu-l-arshi mahmoodun wa hadza Muhammadun (ﷺ). Ya'ni Allah Ta'ala ne mohr-e-nubuwwat ko apne paas ka ek noor bana kar aap par sabt farmaya jo aap ki risalat ki gawah hai. Apne naam ke saath apne Nabi ka naam mila liya jabke paanchwein waqt ash-hadu kehta hai. Aap ki izzat-o-jalal ke izhar ke liye apne naam mein se aap ka naam nikala, dekho woh Arsh wala Mahmood hai aur aap Muhammad hain (ﷺ). Aur log kehte hain ke aglon pichlon mein Allah Ta'ala ne aap ka zikr buland kiya aur tamam Anbiya (Alaihimas Salam) se roz-e-meesaq mein ahd liya gaya ke woh aap par iman layein aur apni apni ummaton ko bhi aap par iman lane ka hukm karein. Phir aap ki ummat mein aap ke zikr ko mashhoor kiya ke Allah ke zikr ke saath aap ka zikr kiya jaye. Sarsari ne kitni achi baat bayan farmayi hai, farmate hain ke farzon ki azan sahih nahin hoti magar aap ke pyare aur meethe naam se jo pasandida aur ache munh se ada ho. Aur farmate hain ke tum nahin dekhte ke hamari azan aur hamara farz sahih nahin hota jab tak ke aap ka zikr baar-baar is mein na aaye. Phir Allah Tabarak-o-Ta'ala takrar aur takeed ke saath do do dafa farmata hai ke sakhti ke saath aasani, dushwari ke saath saholat hai. Ibn-e-Abi Hatim mein hai ke Rasoolullah (ﷺ) baithe hue thay aur aap ke samne ek patthar tha, pas logon ne kaha aur sakhti aaye aur is patthar par ghus jaye to aasani hi aayegi aur isi mein jayegi aur ise nikal layegi, is par yeh aayat utri. Musnad-e-Bazzar mein hai Huzoor (ﷺ) farmate hain ke agar dushwari is patthar mein dakhil ho jaye to aasani aa kar ise nikale gi, phir aap ne is aayat ki tilawat ki. Yeh hadith Aiz bin Shuraih Hazrat Anas (R.A) se riwayat karte hain aur un ke bare mein Abu Hatim Razi ka faisla hai ke un ki hadith mein za'f hai aur Ibn-e-Masood (R.A) se yeh mauqoof marwi hai. Hazrat Hasan (R.H) farmate hain log kehte thay ke ek sakhti do aasaniyon par ghalib nahin aa sakti. Hazrat Hasan Ibn-e-Jareer mein marwi hai ke An-Hazrat (ﷺ) ek din shadan-o-farhan aaye aur hanste hue farmane lage har-giz ek dushwari do narmiyon par ghalib nahin aa sakti. Phir is aayat ki aap ne tilawat ki, yeh hadith mursal hai. Hazrat Qatada (R.H) farmate hain ke hum se zikr kiya gaya hai ke Rasoolullah (ﷺ) ne apne as-hab ko khush-khabri sunayi ke do aasaniyon par ek sakhti ghalib nahin aa sakti. Matlab yeh hai ke 'usra' ke lafz ko to dono jagah ma'rifa laye hain to woh mufrad hua aur 'yusr' ke lafz ko nakira laye hain to woh muta'addid ho gaya.

Ek hadith mein hai ke ma'oonat ya'ni imdad-e-Ilahi ba-qadr-e-ma'oonat ya'ni takleef ke aasman se nazil hoti hai, ya'ni sabr musibat ki miqdar par nazil hota hai. Hazrat Imam Shafi'i (R.H) farmate hain: Sabrun jameelan ma aqrabal faraja, man raqaballaha fil amri naja, man sadaqallaha lam yanlahu aza, wa man rajahu yakoon haithu raja. Ya'ni achha sabr aasaniyon se kya hi qareeb hai? Apne kamon mein Allah Ta'ala ka lihaz rakhne wala, nijat yafta hai, Allah Ta'ala ki baton ki tasdeeq karne wale ko koi eza nahin pahunchti, us se bhalai ki umeed rakhne wala use apni umeed ke sath hi pata hai. Hazrat Abu Hatim Sajistani (R.H) ke ashaar hain ke jab mayusi dil par qabza kar leti hai aur seena bawajood kushadgi ke tang ho jata hai, takleefein gher leti hain aur musibatein dera jama leti hain, koi chara sujhayi nahin deta aur koi tadbeer-e-nijat kargar nahin hoti, us waqt achanak Allah ki madad aa pahunchti hai. Aur woh duaon ka sunne wala bareek been Allah us sakhti ko aasani se aur us takleef ko rahat mein badal deta hai. Tangiyan jab ke bharpoor aa padi hain, Parwardigar wahan wus'atein nazil farma kar nuqsan ko faide se badal deta hai. Kisi aur shayar ne kaha hai: Wa rubba nazilin yadeequ bihil fata zar'an, wa indallahi minha al-makhraju. Kamalat falamma istahlat halaqatuha, farijat wa kana yazunnuha la tufraju. Ya'ni bahut si aisi musibatein insan par nazil hoti hain jin se woh tang-dil ho jata hai halanke Allah ke paas un se chhutkara bhi hai. Jab yeh musibatein kamil ho jati hain aur is zanjeer ke halqe mazboot ho jate hain aur insan guman karne lagta hai ke bhala yeh kya hatengi, ke achanak us Raheem-o-Kareem Allah ki shafqat bhari nazrein padti hain aur us musibat ko is tarah door karta hai ke goya aayi hi na thi. Is ke baad irshad-e-Bari hota hai ke jab tu dunyawi kamon se aur yahan ke ashghal se fursat paye to hamari ibadaton mein lag ja aur farigh-ul-bal ho kar dili tawajjuh ke sath hamare samne aajizi mein lag ja, apni niyat khalis kar le, apni poori raghbat ke sath hamari janab ki taraf mutawajjah ho ja. Isi ma'ni ki woh hadith hai jis ki sehat par ittefaq hai jis mein hai ke khana samne majood hone ke waqt namaz nahin aur is halat mein bhi ke insan ko pakhana peshab ki hajat ho. Aur hadith mein hai ke jab namaz khadi ki jaye aur sham ka khana samne majood ho to pehle khane se faraghat hasil kar lo. Hazrat Mujahid (R.H) is ayat ki tafsir mein farmate hain ke jab amr-e-dunya se farigh ho kar namaz ke liye khade ho to mehnat ke sath ibadat karo aur mashghuliyat ke sath Rabb ki taraf tawajjuh kar. Hazrat Ibn-e-Mas'ood (R.A) farmate hain ke jab farz namaz se farigh ho to tahajjud ki namaz mein khada ho. Hazrat Abdullah bin Mas'ood (R.A) farmate hain ke namaz se farigh ho kar baithe hue apne Rabb ki taraf tawajjuh kar. Hazrat Abdullah bin Abbas (R.A) farmate hain ya'ni dua kar. Zaid bin Aslam aur Zahhak farmate hain jihad se farigh ho kar Allah ki ibadat mein lag ja. Thauri (R.H) farmate hain apni niyat aur apni raghbat Allah hi ki taraf rakh.

Surah Al-Nashrah ki tafsir Allah ke fazl-o-karam se khatam hui. Falhamdulillah.
